{{Quote|The Mirr is for the Mystics. Only they can see.|Tolec-Da|<ref name="A Potential Problem" />}}
'''Tolec-Da''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. He was obsessed to find a lost artifact, the [[Mirr]], that he believed upgrade the powers of the Mystics. To find the Mirr Tolec-Da started to collaborated with the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Sallius Wen]]. At the [[Kri-Ta Outpost]] Tolec-Da and Wen decided together to ask a republic hero to find and retrieve the Mirr. Unfortunately for the Voss, Wen eventually discovered that the Mirr was in fact a [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifact]] and secretly told to the hero to destroy it instead of bringing it back.<ref name="A Potential Problem" />
